subject: FYI: supabase/postgres image's auth.uid() reads request.jwt.claim.sub only
body: In supabase/postgres:17.11.0.019 (no GoTrue migrations applied) auth.uid() is `select nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid` - it ignores request.jwt.claims. Hosted Supabase reads both. So as_user() must set BOTH: set_config('request.jwt.claims', json, true) AND set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', uuid, true) (I also set request.jwt.claim.role). That is what naadi_api/auth_db.py user_tx does; otherwise every RLS insert fails locally/CI with 'new row violates row-level security policy'. Alternative: your migration could create-or-replace auth.uid() to the hosted coalesce form - I would rather not touch the auth schema; setting both is harmless.
